title: Edit: deeper pocket, fillet survives
prompt: Make the pocket 5 mm deeper. Keep the rounded inside corners (the fillet feature).

hidden_tests.description: Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
The pocket's four vertical corners are still rounded R5
The fillet still rounds the same four edges as before the edit (same keys), resolved exactly
13 mm deep pocket with R5 corners: 75299 mm³

notes: The fillet selects the pocket's vertical side edges by query (pocket.sides().edges().parallel(Z)): deepening the pocket lengthens those edges but keeps their keys, so the reference stays exact. Construction: fillet_kept reads the fillet features the prompt asks for (no geometry equivalent in the report), so a correct part built otherwise fails only that test.
